title: DraftSaveRequest
description: POST /api/pipelines/:id/draft/save body (HEL-1629, docs/live-draft-preview.md section 8). `steps` and `outputs` are the FINAL tree, diffed against the stored definition: an item carrying an `id` is an existing step or Output of THIS pipeline (any other id is a 400: explicit ids are accepted only when the server restores a journaled definition on undo); an item carrying a `clientId` is new. A step names exactly one of `parentStepId` (an existing step of the draft), `parentClientId` (a new step of the draft) or `rootId` (a parentless step names its root); an Output names exactly one of `nodeStepId`, `nodeStepClientId` or `rootId`. A stored step the draft omits is DELETED, with its tail subtree only if the draft omits it too: the server never deletes a step the draft keeps. `baseFingerprint` is the `fingerprint` of the `GET /api/pipelines/:id` the draft was based on; a stale base answers 409 PATCH_SET_STALE and there is no overwrite path of any kind. Removals (steps, Outputs and the panels and alert rules they cascade into) must be listed in `confirmCascade`, else 422 with the impact.

runAfterSave.description: When set, the server submits a run through the unchanged HEL-505 guard AFTER the save has committed. A guard rejection is reported in the response and never rolls the save back.
